findings.evidence: scripts/lint-scope.sh:52-55 `compare=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/compare/$BASE...$HEAD")` / `jq -r '.commits[].commit.message | split("\n")[0]' | sed -nE 's/.*\(#([0-9]+)\)$/\1/p'`, with the comment "Each PR lands as one squashed commit titled `... (#N)`"; scripts/test_lint_scope.py:89 `test_merge_group_reads_prs_from_squash_titles`.
findings.fix: Factor the convention into one place: put the compare-plus-subject-to-PR-numbers step in a single helper (e.g. a `merge_group_prs` function in a small shared module) and have `lint-scope.sh` call it (`python3 scripts/...`) instead of its own jq/sed pipeline; failing that, at minimum cite `scripts/lint-scope.sh:53` at `SQUASH_PR_RE` so the two stay in step.
findings.issue: `group_subjects` + `group_prs` (lines 46, 94, 159) re-implement the merge-group PR list that `scripts/lint-scope.sh:52-55` already computes: the same `gh api repos/$REPO/compare/$BASE...$HEAD` call, the same first-line-of-commit-message extraction, the same `(#N)`-suffix regex (`sed -nE 's/.*\(#([0-9]+)\)$/\1/p'` vs `SQUASH_PR_RE = r"\(#(\d+)\)\s*$"`). Two copies of the squash-title convention will drift; lint-scope.sh also fails closed when a subject carries no number (`nprs -eq ncommits`, line 58) while `group_prs` silently drops it, so the two already disagree.

findings.evidence: structure_nudge.py:169-179 `prev = next((c["id"] for c in comments if MARKER in (c["body"] or "")), None)` then `gh api -X PATCH repos/.../issues/comments/{prev}` else POST; pr-profile.yml:744-757 `update_comment()` with the same find-then-PATCH-else-`gh pr comment` shape.
findings.fix: Extract one helper (e.g. `upsert_marked_comment(repo, pr, marker_re, body, token)` in a shared `scripts/` module) and call it from `merge_queue_report.py` and `structure_nudge.py`; the only new behaviour here is keying the marker by head SHA, which is a parameter, not a new mechanism.
findings.issue: `upsert_comment` is a third copy of "paginate /issues/N/comments, match a hidden marker, PATCH that comment else POST a new one": `scripts/structure_nudge.py:166-179` does exactly this in Python, and `.github/workflows/pr-profile.yml:744-757` does it in shell for two markers.

summary: The report itself is new functionality with no existing equivalent, but two blocks re-derive logic that already exists in scripts/: the merge-group PR extraction duplicated from lint-scope.sh, and the marker-keyed comment upsert duplicated from structure_nudge.py and pr-profile.yml.
